row:
Dog lover? You're at the right place!

Embark on our journey to discovering something new about dogs each day! There is so much to learn about our canine companions we just can't get enough of it and want to share it with our followers every day.

Our content is produced by the professionals in the industry,  dog trainers, dog behavior consultants, dog groomers and veterinarians. We try to stay updated on the most recent research, although sometimes, we can just make some assumptions in areas where research is lacking.

So if you're eager to learn more about your canine companion, make sure to like us and subscribe and don't forget to also join our big community at Dog Discoveries on Quora and Facebook so you can fetch our free Daily Dog Discoveries freshly delivered to you each day. 

Dogs are fascinating creatures and there is always so much to discover!
